title: Library Explorer Script
description: Write a script that demonstrates two hacking libraries and save requirements.
problemStatement:
Inside a project folder (e.g., `library_demo`), activate a virtual environment and install `requests` and `beautifulsoup4`. Then write a script `demo.py` that:
- Imports both libraries.
- Uses `requests` to fetch the content of `http://example.com`.
- Prints the HTTP status code.
- Parses the page title (the text inside `<title>`) using BeautifulSoup.
- Prints the title.

Finally, generate a `requirements.txt` for this project. Run the script to confirm it works.
hints: If you get a 'module not found' error, ensure the venv is activated and packages installed.
solutionCode:
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

response = requests.get('http://example.com')
print(f"Status code: {response.status_code}")

soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, 'html.parser')
print(f"Title: {soup.title.string}")
